ios.desc:
Buy, sell and exchange cryptocurrency on one of the most popular bitcoin wallets in the world. Always fast, easy, private, and secure. 

We make it easy to buy bitcoin (BTC), bitcoin cash (BCH), ethereum (ETH), Litecoin (LTC), Dogecoin (DOGE), ERC-20 tokens, and several other cryptocurrencies. Also hold your favorite DeFi tokens such as UNI, SUSHI, and more!

BRD is trusted by over 10 million users in over 170 countries and has more than $20 billion USD in cryptocurrency under protection. 

• EASY PURCHASING
Buy bitcoin (BTC), bitcoin cash (BCH), ethereum (ETH),  Litecoin (LTC), Dogecoin (DOGE), and other cryptocurrencies with a credit card, checking account, cash, or other cryptocurrency. Trade bitcoin (BTC), bitcoin cash (BCH), ethereum (ETH) and many popular ERC20 tokens, as well as, Litecoin (LTC), Dogecoin (DOGE), and many other cryptocurrencies. 

• UNHACKABLE PROTECTION
Store all your valuable cryptocurrencies in a virtually unhackable environment, all for free! Your crypto wallet is protected on your own device utilizing industry-leading hardware encryption and Apple's mobile security.

• TOTAL PRIVACY
No signup is required. BRD Is a non-custodial wallet, which means you are in total control of your privacy and wallet funds.

• FAST SUPPORT
Get all your questions answered in less than 2 hours. Our global support team is ready to help, from first-time bitcoin buyers to longtime crypto holders.

The BRD wallet has been consistently praised for its ease-of-use, leading security, and dedication to privacy.

Want to see your favorite feature added to the next version of BRD? We'd love to hear from you at support@brd.com.

Thank you for all of your five star reviews! 

Start today with the fastest growing, most secure bitcoin wallet!
